Settlement-means prose says Nostro while regex says NOS. Do not infer normalization. Mandatory means nonempty; optional populated fields still meet their length/format constraints. Question-mark entries remain undefined.

claim_register.claim: MT103 requires field57 BIC, beneficiary account/address/charges, and ordering account/address/name. MT103 plus RUB requires field57 account, whose length/format remain unknown. MT202 with Over-Account also requires beneficiary account. For MT202, missing beneficiary name requires BIC; missing BIC requires name. Beneficiary account length is2–34; ordering account is1–50. Ordering name maximum is70. Charges allow OUR/SHA/BEN. Explicitly constrained BICs require8 or11 uppercase alphanumeric characters. Intermediary account, ordering BIC and receiver-correspondent account retain unknown specifications.
